    PLATFORM INSIGHTS

    What Namma Sathi Brings Together

    A single agentic core, purpose-built for three domains people navigate every day.

    0
    Specialized agents, one orchestrator
    0
    Languages supported for voice & text
    0
    Agentic steps: understand → plan → act → verify → explain
    0%
    Human approval kept in the loop where it matters

    Why an orchestrator, not three apps

    Healthcare, agriculture and civic needs rarely arrive labeled. Namma Sathi listens once, classifies intent, and routes to the right specialized agent — so people describe their problem in their own words instead of learning three different apps.

    ABOUT THE PROJECT

    One orchestrator. Three agents. A human in the loop.

    Namma Sathi is a national-hackathon prototype exploring how one agentic AI core can responsibly help people navigate healthcare, agriculture and public services — through text, voice, and their own language.

    HTML5CSS3Vanilla JavaScriptWeb Speech APINo frameworks

    Core Flow

    Every request — regardless of domain — moves through the same accountable pipeline.

    User
    Text / Voice / Multilingual Input
    Namma Sathi AI Orchestrator
    Intent + Context Understanding
    Agent Selection
    Healthcare / Agriculture / Civic Agent
    Knowledge + Tool Layer
    Plan → Execute → Verify
    Human Approval When Required
    Result + Explanation

    A note on the data in this prototype

    Hospital availability, weather, crop analysis and government workflow details shown throughout this site are simulated for demonstration purposes and clearly marked as such. No live medical, agricultural or government systems are connected in this build.
